card.name: Cooking recipe step wording
card.fires_on: Small connecting or instruction words inside recipe directions, such as 'until' after a cooking time, 'aside' after 'set', and 'heat' in 'over medium heat'.

modes.label: until after cooking time
modes.description: The word 'until' (often after 'or') introducing a doneness condition in a cooking step.
modes.example: cook chicken in oil over medium heat for five to six minutes on each side or<< until>> meat thermometer reaches a temperature of 1

modes.label: Other step words
modes.description: Verbs and particles in recipe steps like 'aside', 'Season', 'Combine', or 'to' when moving food.
modes.example: Stir in tomato paste and set<< aside>>. 2. Pat meat dry with paper
